skill_name: Compare and contrast the differences between the four Greek goddesses.
workflow: Hera, Athena, Aphrodite, and Demeter are four of the most important goddesses in Greek mythology. Hera was the goddess of family and marriage, while Athena was the goddess of wisdom and warrior skills. Aphrodite was the goddess of beauty and love, while Demeter was the goddess of harvest and fertility.
